result.topic_en: Euler shows that the variation sign δ commutes with the differential d and with integral signs, gives integration-by-parts rules for removing d from δv inside integrals, and begins applying these rules to maxima and minima problems for ∫Z dx where Z itself contains integrals.
result.transcription:
114 DE METHODO

XXXII.
Deinde si haec duplicis generis differentialia inter se permisceantur, ex superioribus iam constat esse
$\delta\, d\, V = d\, \delta\, V.$
Hinc si V iam sit differentiale formae $dV$, erit
$\delta\, ddU = d\delta\, dU = dd\delta\, U$, ob $\delta\, dU = d\delta\, V$ [?]
atque in genere, quotcunque ordine bina differentiationis signa $d$ et $\delta$ fuerint constituta, eorum ordo pro lubitu permutari potest salua significatione: sic erit
$\delta\, d^3V = d\delta\, d^2V = d^2\delta\, dV = d^3\delta\, V.$
Quia autem hic vnicum statum variatum consideramus, ad quem transitus signo $\delta$ indicatur, hoc signum nunquam plus quam semel in huiusmodi compositionibus inesse potest; semper autem e re est signum $\delta$ in talibus formulis in vltimum locum promouere.

XXXIII.
Eadem permutatio quoque ad signa integralia extenditur; si enim proponatur formula integralis $\int V$, denotante $\int$ summam omnium valorum in eodem statu, qui omnibus valoribus ipsius $x$ respondent, sumtorum, erit etiam
$\delta \int V = \int \delta V$
id quod per se est perspicuum, cum incrementum translatitium totius summae aequale sit summae omnium incrementorum elementarium in eadem translatione existentium. Atque ex hoc ipso fonte superior Analysis est deducta; nam cum proposita esset formula integralis $\int Z\, dx$, cuius variatio in statum variatum erat

115 MAXIMORVM ET MINIMORVM.

definienda, affirmauimus esse $\delta \int Z\, dx = \int \delta(Z\, dx) = \int \delta Z . dx$, quia $\delta(Z\, dx) = \delta Z\, dx + Z\, \delta\, dx$, est vero $\delta\, dx = 0$, vti $\delta\, x = 0$. Quin etiam si occurreret integratio geminata $\int\int V$, foret eodem modo
$\delta \int\int V = \int \delta \int V = \int\int \delta\, V.$

XXXIV.
Alterum artificium in transformatione integralium, quando post signum integrale signa $d$ et $\delta$ inuicem coniunguntur, vt saltem in integratione signum $\delta$ solitarium relinquatur. Ita proposita formula integrali $\int V\, \delta\, dv$, ob $\delta\, dv = d\, \delta\, v$, considerando $\delta\, v$ vti quantitatem simplicem, erit
$\int V\, \delta\, dv = \int V\, d\, \delta\, v = V\, \delta\, v - \int \delta\, v\, dV.$
Eodemque porro modo perspicitur fore:
$\int V\, dd\delta v = V d\delta v - \delta v\, dV + \int \delta v\, ddV$
$\int V d^3\delta v = V dd\delta v - d\delta v\, dV + \delta v\, ddV - \int \delta v\, d^3V$
$\int V d^4\delta v = V d^3\delta v - d^2\delta v\, dV + d\delta v\, ddV - \delta v\, d^3V + \int \delta v\, d^4V$
etc.
est enim $\int V\, dd\delta v = V\, d\delta v - \int d\delta v\, dV$, at est
$\int d\, \delta\, v\, dV = \delta\, v\, dV - \int \delta\, v\, d\, d\, V$
vnde ratio harum transformationum perspicitur.

XXXV.
His regulis analyticis praemissis non erit difficile, omnes quaestiones huiusmodi circa maxima et minima resoluere, etiamsi in formula $\int Z dx$ functio Z formulas integrales quascunque in se contineat. Totum negotium, scilicet, huc redit, vt incrementum $\delta \int Z dx$, quod formula proposita $\int Z dx$, dum a statu principali in
P 2

items.quote: atque in genere, quotcunque ordine bina differentiationis signa $d$ et $\delta$ fuerint constituta, eorum ordo pro lubitu permutari potest salua significatione
items.english: And in general, in whatever order the two differentiation signs d and δ are arranged, their order may be permuted at will without changing the meaning.

items.quote: Eadem permutatio quoque ad signa integralia extenditur
items.english: The same permutation also extends to integral signs (δ∫V = ∫δV).
In the same way it is further seen that the following transformations hold for ∫V d^nδv.

items.quote: His regulis analyticis praemissis non erit difficile, omnes quaestiones huiusmodi circa maxima et minima resoluere, etiamsi in formula $\int Z dx$ functio Z formulas integrales quascunque in se contineat.
items.english: With these analytic rules established, it will not be difficult to solve all such questions concerning maxima and minima, even if in the formula ∫Z dx the function Z contains any integral formulas whatever.
